source.datasetRecord: PMC13191044; paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy behavioural study in Sprague–Dawley rats
source.citation: Kim SJ et al. Gender-Specific Behavior Reductions in Spontaneous Locomotive and Rearing in a Rat Model of Paclitaxel-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy: A Pilot Study. Journal of Pain Research. 2026;19:565512.
source.primaryProtocolCitation: Kim et al. 2026, Paclitaxel Administration and Results; Figures 4–6

supportingSources.citation: Griffiths LA, Duggett NA, Pitcher AL, Flatters SJL. Evoked and ongoing pain-like behaviours in a rat model of paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy. Pain Research and Management. 2018;2018:8217613.
supportingSources.role: independent longitudinal sensory and ethological behavioural evidence

protocol.formulation: Taxol diluted in saline from 6 mg/mL stock in 1:1 Cremophor EL:ethanol
protocol.frequency: 6 mg/kg every other day for four injections
protocol.control: Sex-matched vehicle groups received Cremophor EL:ethanol vehicle diluted with saline

behaviour.finding: Distance travelled decreased from baseline and was lower than vehicle on day 8 (post-hoc p = 0.0022 and p = 0.0050 respectively)
Distance travelled decreased from baseline on day 8 (post-hoc p = 0.0022)
Rearing frequency decreased from baseline and was lower than vehicle on day 8 (post-hoc p = 0.022 and p = 0.00040 respectively)
No statistically significant effect on rearing frequency was reported
Mechanical and cold hypersensitivity had delayed onset after the four-dose course; mechanical hypersensitivity persisted for several months (n = 12–21 per group depending on timepoint)
Burrowing and nocturnal wheel-running were impaired at peak pain-like behaviour; no motor-coordination deficit was reported

websiteUse.scope: Rat paclitaxel peripheral-neuropathy behaviour and sensory phenotype teaching.
approvedClaims: Observed delayed mechanical/cold hypersensitivity and impaired ethological behaviour
prohibitedClaims: Numerical graph estimates presented as measurements
displayRequirements: Show sex and assay where relevant

blockingIssues: The two supporting studies provide behavioural endpoints, not plasma PK or nerve histology
